item.title: Teadust-Glaze Tea Cup with Raised Gold and Enamel - Jingdezhen, Jiangxi
item.description: Teadust glaze - an iron crystalline glaze fired in a reduction kiln, first made in the Tang dynasty and perfected at Jingdezhen under the Qing, where it became one of the prized monochromes. Here the mottled olive ground is banded with ribs of raised gold and studded with coloured enamel, the well painted with a medallion of beasts and lotus, the base sealed with a longevity roundel. Origin / material: Jingdezhen, Jiangxi. SKU T09. One of a kind - only one available.

item.title: Gufa Gilded Zisha Teapot in 24K Gold - Yixing, Jiangsu

Each firing is a gamble — only the few that come out with the true gufa depth are gilded at all. The finished surface is then burnished by hand with wool felt, thousands of passes, until the gold turns soft and deep rather than bright. Red zisha clay within. Origin / material: Yixing, Jiangsu. SKU Z29. One of a kind - only one available.
